utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, I heard there's a repair drive happening. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's on Saturday at the community center. I'm bringing some tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, I thought it was Sunday at the community center? Did the date change?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just finished my part on the south end. Are you interested in helping with the benches, Uli?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm sorry, Opal, I've got some things to take care of at home. But thank you for asking.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem at all, Uli. Let me know if you free up later.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I'm planning to go! I've been telling everyone about it. Are you thinking of joining?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I'll be there. I've got an old lamp that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Noah, I'm reviewing the tool drop-off points now. Can you confirm the times?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the times? I thought it was Saturday, but somebody said Sunday? I'm not sure anymore.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Saturday, 10am to 4pm at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hi Cleo! Yes, I'm planning to bring some old toasters and a wobbly chair. Vik said they need all the help they can get.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Ira, just so you know, the repair drive is actually on Sunday now, not Saturday. Same time and place though!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, Sunday? Oh, thanks for the heads up, Tess! I'll mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, I heard about the repair drive this Saturday, but I'm not sure where it is—school or community center. I'm too busy to help out, though.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Bo! If you change your mind or need any tools borrowed, just holler.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate the offer, but I'm definitely swamped this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rey! Do you know about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? I keep forgetting the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about it. I was actually heading to your garage to pick up the instructions—do you have them?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Instructions? Um, I think I left them on my workbench... or maybe in the car? Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? We've got tools and volunteers ready!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, absolutely! I'll be there at the school this Saturday. Looking forward to it!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wonderful, Faye! I'll see you there. We have a good group coming together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief, Gus! Rosa, do you think you could also bring any spare tools you might have?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia! I'm already planning to bring some tools and snacks for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's wonderful, Rosa! Should we set a time to meet before the drive to organize everything?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, I heard from Rosa that it's been moved to Sunday. Same place and time, just a day later.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, really? I've been telling everyone Saturday. Let me check with the organizers to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was set for Saturday. I don't like last-minute changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sunday? Who changed it? I need to see the updated notice.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I had already blocked out Saturday for this. I hope whoever changed it knows what they're doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, sure! I think there's a sign-up sheet pinned up at the community center bulletin board. I can walk you over there if you like!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn! Before we go, could you remind me what time the repair drive starts on Saturday? I want to make sure I'm not late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, it starts at 9 AM sharp on Saturday. Want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Sam — is the repair work at Oren's garage or at the school? I want to be sure I'm heading to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, Hana, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center, not at Oren's garage or the school.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the community center on Sunday, got it. Thanks for clarifying, Sam!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Faye, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, absolutely! I'm helping organize it. It's at the school this Saturday. Would you like to join us?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was at the community center. Did the location change?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive this Saturday. I might have an old bike to bring.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday? I thought I heard something about Sunday from Sam... but maybe I'm mixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I thought it was Saturday... I'll check with Sam later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Oren, are you bringing any supplies to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Supplies? I think I was supposed to bring my toaster, but I can't remember where I put it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, the toaster! I can help you look for it if you want. We need all the donations we can get.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing, Kira! I can send you a link to the online sign-up sheet or show you the paper one at the community center. Want me to do that?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Quinn! That's perfect. I think a lot of people will appreciate having both options.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Jules! Glad you're on board. Could you help me spread the word to folks on your street?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane! The repair drive is actually on Sunday now at the community center, same time, 10 AM. I'm bringing my wrench set—you should come!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, thanks for clarifying, Tess! I must've gotten mixed up. I'll be there on Sunday with my toolbox. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, looking forward to seeing you there!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief to hear, Leo. Gus mentioned he'll bring his tools, so hopefully that covers the shortage.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'm confirming the drop-off points with Opal by noon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks Leo. Let me know if Opal needs any help coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Rey, are you interested in joining the repair drive? We need more help with the benches.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I was actually about to head to Oren's garage to pick up the instructions. Want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, let me grab my jacket and I'll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, did you hear about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yes, the repair drive! It's this Saturday at the community center from 10am to 4pm, fixing old electronics and furniture together!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'm glad you already know! I was thinking of bringing in a broken lamp; do you think we can fix it there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Eli! I'm glad you're here. Quick update: the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, still at 10 AM. Can you still make it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I see. I had it in my calendar for Saturday, but I can adjust. I'll be there Sunday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, see you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I've heard rumors. But is there an actual official notice or sign-up sheet? I'd like to see something concrete.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard from Vik, so it's pretty solid. But if you want official word, maybe check the community board?
